The Firm

A scientist’s discipline, applied to your family’s plan.

Spearheaded is a private planning practice for incorporated professionals, business owners and families across the Greater Toronto Area.

The Founder

Sajad Moshkelgosha, PhD

Founder · Licensed Insurance Advisor, Ontario

Sajad holds a PhD in Immunology and Medical Genetics and built his career as a research scientist in Toronto, where every conclusion has to survive scrutiny. He founded Spearheaded to bring the same rigour to private planning.

Each plan begins with evidence — your structure, your numbers, your intentions — and every recommendation is explained in plain language and in writing, so you can see exactly why it is there and what it costs.

How we work

Four commitments.

I

Evidence first

We start from your actual position and model the alternatives before recommending anything.

II

Everything in writing

Recommendations, costs and risks are set out on paper, in language you can share with your family.

III

Coordinated advice

We work alongside your accountant and lawyer, so the plan fits the structure you already have.

IV

For the long term

Annual reviews as your corporation, your family and the rules change over the years.
